mapper.sql: t.id, t.test_name, t.test_type, t.category_id, c.category_name, display_version.cover_url, display_version.draw_question_count, display_version.estimated_minutes, t.status, display_version.version_no AS current_version_no, display_version.version_status AS current_version_status, t.home_display, t.home_sort, t.update_date

LEFT JOIN t_test_version display_version ON display_version.id = ( SELECT v.id FROM t_test_version v WHERE v.test_id = t.id AND v.deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.version_status = 1 THEN 0 WHEN v.version_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, v.version_no DESC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM t_test t JOIN t_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0
WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_ai_generation_task ai_task JOIN t_test_version ai_version ON ai_version.id = ai_task.version_id WHERE ai_version.test_id = t.id AND ai_task.deleted = 0 AND ai_task.task_status != 5 )
AND t.test_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND t.test_type = #{query.testType} AND t.category_id = #{query.categoryId} AND t.status = #{query.status} ORDER BY t.update_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT FROM t_test t JOIN t_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0
WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
